description: Kamaji is the Hosted Control Plane Manager for Kubernetes.

Seerr (formerly Jellyseerr): media request management for Jellyfin, Emby and Plex with Sonarr and Radarr integration, user quotas and notifications, with settings and the database on a volume. Hardened by QuenchWorks: built from source, nonroot, CVE-gated, cosign-signed and pinned by digest.
